propositions: ADR 0035 section (d) must specify the concrete backend interface (Protocols and RemoteRef) to unblock Phase 2 implementation story decomposition and plan-review.
Rebar's local ticket schema is the canonical model; adapters translate vendor↔local via existing mappers; no separate CanonicalTicket or parallel rebar↔canonical schema.

Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) plus optional capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) are unified behind a Backend facade keyed on config.reconciler.backend.
RemoteRef{vendor, instance, remote_id} type replaces hardcoded "jira" literals and bare jira_key references in apply_inbound_records.py.
The ADR revision documents three leak-fixes: ADF-sizing removal from differ, lossy-status and parent rules moved to Jira adapter, duplicated value-maps and link-constants single-sourced.
The proof-of-seam includes contract test suite and test-only FakeBackend; the real GitHub adapter is deferred to epic be74.
